ibperf._comment_install_system_packages: Set True to sudo apt install the perftest build and runtime packages on every node (skipped in Spur/Slurm job steps). When False, install fails if numactl, libibverbs or librdmacm is missing on any node.
ibperf._comment_rocm_dir: ROCm installation path. Set to auto-detect from /opt/rocm or /opt/rocm/core-* if left as changeme
ibperf._comment_require_dmabuf: Fail before launching if perftest on any node lacks --use_rocm_dmabuf. Set False to run without DMA-BUF (recorded in results).
ibperf._comment_ib_bw_test_list: Bandwidth tests to run. Supported: ib_write_bw, ib_read_bw, ib_send_bw. Omit the key to run all three; [] skips bandwidth tests.
ibperf._comment_ib_lat_test_list: Latency tests to run. Supported: ib_write_lat, ib_read_lat, ib_send_lat. Omit the key to run ib_write_lat and ib_send_lat; [] skips latency tests.
ibperf._comment_gid_index: GID index passed to perftest -x. Set to 'auto' (or remove) to pick the lowest index usable on every NIC used: gid_type with an IPv4-mapped address on RoCE, any populated GID (normally 0) on InfiniBand. Validated against gid_type on every node/NIC before perftest launches.
ibperf._comment_gid_type: Expected sysfs GID type for gid_index; 'any' disables the type check. Not enforced on InfiniBand link layers.
